title: pineapple_green vs yellow fruit_509_rep1
characteristics_ch1: developmental stage: pine9 mature yellow pineapple fruit
label_protocol_ch1: Total RNA labelled with Cy3 and Cy5 using the LabelStar Array Kit (Qiagen) as per manufacturers instructions.
characteristics_ch2: developmental stage: pine3 mature green pineapple fruit
label_protocol_ch2: Total RNA labelled with Cy3 and Cy5 using the LabelStar Array Kit (Qiagen) as per manufacturers instructions.
hyb_protocol: Labelled cDNA was mixed with  20xSSC (20ul), liquid block (12ul), 2%SDS (4ul) and dH2O (up to 200ul total vol). Denatured labelled target was hybridised in submersible hybridisation cassette chambers (Ambion) at 55°C for 12h. Arrays then washed in 2x SSC (+0.5 % SDS), 1x SSC, 0.5x SSC and 0.05x SSC, each at RT  for 5 min prior to drying and scanning.
scan_protocol: Scanning was undertaken in an ArrayWorx scanner (Applied Precision)
data_processing: Two raw data files for each slide; The first (*raw.txt) is the original raw data containing everything and the second (*2xSD+new_raw.txt) is an updated version of the first where many are filtered out that don't fall within 2 x standard deviations of the average.  Also, the second raw data files contains a batch of new sequence IDs that were flagged unsequenced (ie. JBW type, not contig # type) in the first original raw data.  Most of the new sequences were actually left out of the microarray, because they were found to be abundant from an earlier pineapple EST cDNA library report.
data_processing.2: Spot editing was undertaken using SoftWorx Tracker. Data analysis was carried out using Genespring for biological replicate slides 506, 516 and 985. For each replicate slide, the mean and background intensity values from each channel (W595, W685) were log2 transformed and normalized using the LOWESS algorithm to remove intensity dependent effects within the calculated values.  Normalised values were used to calculate the Cy3/Cy5 fluorescence ratios from experimental and biological repeats before all replicates were combined (see Series Data Table). Data was compiled from three hybridisations, including one dye-swap replicate.
